prompt: I'm submitting an NTE rate of $120/hour in my master bid Year 1 (2026). My base wage cost is $85/hour with a 32% markup. Model the 7-year contract lifecycle...

assertions.text: Produces comprehensive year-by-year projection with all required columns
assertions.evidence: Output includes Year, Date, Bill Rate, Wage Cost, Margin $, Margin % for all 7 years

assertions.text: Applies correct CPI adjustments (2.3% annually) to bill rates
assertions.evidence: Year 1: $120.00 → Year 2: $122.76 (2.3% increase), continuing correctly through Year 7

assertions.text: Applies correct wage inflation (3.5% annually) to wage costs
assertions.evidence: Year 1: $85.00 → Year 2: $87.98 (3.5% increase), continuing correctly through Year 7

assertions.text: Identifies margin crossing below 35% threshold and explains structural cause
assertions.evidence: Correctly identifies Year 1 margin at 29.17% (below threshold), shows cumulative 5.13pp erosion, attributes to wage inflation exceeding CPI escalation

assertions.text: Provides actionable strategic implications and repricing recommendations
assertions.evidence: Recommends Year 1 NTE of $130.77 to achieve 35% margin, identifies wage-CPI gap as profitability leak, suggests escalation mechanisms
